import argparse
from pathlib import Path

from mdlite.render import extract_title, render_page


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Convert Markdown to a standalone HTML page.")
    parser.add_argument("source")
    parser.add_argument("-o", "--output")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    source = Path(args.source)
    output = Path(args.output) if args.output else source.with_suffix(".html")
    text = source.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    output.write_text(render_page(text, extract_title(text)), encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"wrote {output}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

# MarkdownLite A tiny converter written in **plain Python**. It understands *emphasis*, `inline code` and [links](https://www.python.org). ## What it supports - headings from `#` to `######` - bullet lists like this one - numbered lists - block quotes and code fences ### Steps to use it 1. Write some Markdown 2. Run `python convert.py sample.md` 3. Open the HTML file in a browser > Good tools are small enough to understand. > Then you can change them. --- Here is a code sample with characters HTML cares about: ```html

5 < 6 && 7 > 3

``` Done. Escaped text such as this is shown literally.

import os import tempfile import unittest import convert from mdlite.render import extract_title, render_page class RenderTests(unittest.TestCase): def test_title_comes_from_first_heading(self): self.assertEqual(extract_title("intro\n# Real Title\n"), "Real Title") def test_title_default(self): self.assertEqual(extract_title("no heading"), "Document") def test_page_wraps_body(self): page = render_page("# Hi\n\ntext") self.assertIn("Hi", page) self.assertIn("

Hi

", page) self.assertTrue(page.rstrip().endswith("")) def test_convert_writes_file(self): with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp: source = os.path.join(tmp, "doc.md") with open(source, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle: handle.write("# Doc\n\n**bold**") self.assertEqual(convert.main([source]), 0) with open(os.path.join(tmp, "doc.html"), encoding="utf-8") as handle: self.assertIn("bold", handle.read()) if __name__ == "__main__": unittest.main()
